# SDF Library Shaders

Complete, runnable shaders for each demo in the SDF Library notes.

---

## circle-2d

```glsl
float sdCircle(vec2 p, float r) {
    return length(p) - r;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float d = sdCircle(p, 1.0);

    // Color by sign: blue inside, orange outside
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    // Darken near the boundary
    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Highlight the zero level set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## box-2d

```glsl
float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 halfSize) {
    vec2 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float d = sdBox(p, vec2(0.8, 0.5));

    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## box-3d

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Hit {
    float t;
    vec3 point;
    vec3 normal;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Light {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 halfSize) {
    vec3 d = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)), 0.0);
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    return sdBox(p, vec3(0.8, 0.5, 0.6));
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sceneSDF(p);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(Hit hit, Light light, vec3 viewDir) {
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(hit.normal, light.dir));
    vec3 reflected = reflect(-light.dir, hit.normal);
    float specular = pow(max(0.0, dot(reflected, viewDir)), 32.0);

    vec3 diff = hit.color * light.color * diffuse;
    vec3 spec = light.color * specular * 0.5;
    return diff + spec;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);

    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        Hit hit;
        hit.t = t;
        hit.point = p;
        hit.normal = normal;
        hit.color = vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.2);

        vec3 ambient = hit.color * 0.1;
        color = ambient + shade(hit, light, -ray.dir);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## capped-cylinder

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Hit {
    float t;
    vec3 point;
    vec3 normal;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Light {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float radius, float halfHeight) {

        float d = sceneSDF(p);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(Hit hit, Light light, vec3 viewDir) {
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(hit.normal, light.dir));
    vec3 reflected = reflect(-light.dir, hit.normal);
    float specular = pow(max(0.0, dot(reflected, viewDir)), 32.0);

    vec3 diff = hit.color * light.color * diffuse;
    vec3 spec = light.color * specular * 0.5;
    return diff + spec;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);

    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        Hit hit;
        hit.t = t;
        hit.point = p;
```

## torus

```glsl

    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

    vec3 point;
    vec3 normal;
    vec3 color;
};

    return ray;
```

## capped-cone

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Hit {
    float t;
    vec3 point;
    vec3 normal;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Light {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdCappedCone(vec3 p, float h, float r1, float r2) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz), p.y);
    vec2 k1 = vec2(r2, h);
    vec2 k2 = vec2(r2 - r1, 2.0 * h);
    vec2 ca = vec2(q.x - min(q.x, (q.y < 0.0) ? r1 : r2),
                   abs(q.y) - h);
    vec2 cb = q - k1 + k2 * clamp(dot(k1 - q, k2) / dot(k2, k2), 0.0, 1.0);
    float s = (cb.x < 0.0 && ca.y < 0.0) ? -1.0 : 1.0;
    return s * sqrt(min(dot(ca, ca), dot(cb, cb)));
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    return sdCappedCone(p, 1.0, 0.8, 0.3);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sceneSDF(p);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(Hit hit, Light light, vec3 viewDir) {
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(hit.normal, light.dir));
    vec3 reflected = reflect(-light.dir, hit.normal);
    float specular = pow(max(0.0, dot(reflected, viewDir)), 32.0);

    vec3 diff = hit.color * light.color * diffuse;
    vec3 spec = light.color * specular * 0.5;
    return diff + spec;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);

    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        Hit hit;
        hit.t = t;
        hit.point = p;
        hit.normal = normal;
        hit.color = vec3(0.8, 0.4, 0.2);

        vec3 ambient = hit.color * 0.1;
        color = ambient + shade(hit, light, -ray.dir);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## capsule

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Hit {
    float t;
    vec3 point;
    vec3 normal;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Light {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float r) {
    vec3 pa = p - a;
    vec3 ba = b - a;
    float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * t) - r;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    return sdCapsule(p, vec3(0.0, -0.8, 0.0), vec3(0.0, 0.8, 0.0), 0.4);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sceneSDF(p);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(Hit hit, Light light, vec3 viewDir) {
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(hit.normal, light.dir));
    vec3 reflected = reflect(-light.dir, hit.normal);
    float specular = pow(max(0.0, dot(reflected, viewDir)), 32.0);

    vec3 diff = hit.color * light.color * diffuse;
    vec3 spec = light.color * specular * 0.5;
    return diff + spec;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);

    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        Hit hit;
        hit.t = t;
        hit.point = p;
        hit.normal = normal;
        hit.color = vec3(0.8, 0.2, 0.4);

        vec3 ambient = hit.color * 0.1;
        color = ambient + shade(hit, light, -ray.dir);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

```glsl
    vec3 diff = hit.color * light.color * diffuse;
    vec3 spec = light.color * specular * 0.5;
    return diff + spec;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);

    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        Hit hit;
        hit.t = t;
        hit.point = p;
        hit.normal = normal;
        hit.color = vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.2);

        color = ambient + shade(hit, light, -ray.dir);
    }
```

## ring-2d

```glsl
float sdRing(vec2 p, float R, float t) {
    return abs(length(p) - R) - t;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float d = sdRing(p, 0.8, 0.2);

    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## triangle-chambers

Visualizes the six chambers of the dihedral group $I_2(3)$ for the equilateral triangle.

```glsl
#define PI 3.14159265

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float r = 1.0;

    // Color chambers: use angle to assign colors
    float angle = atan(p.y, p.x);
    float sector = mod(angle + PI, PI / 3.0);
    float chamber = floor((angle + PI) / (PI / 3.0));

    // Six distinct pastel colors for the six chambers
    vec3 colors[6];
    colors[0] = vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.5);
    colors[1] = vec3(0.5, 0.9, 0.5);
    colors[2] = vec3(0.5, 0.5, 0.9);
    colors[3] = vec3(0.9, 0.9, 0.5);
    colors[4] = vec3(0.9, 0.5, 0.9);
    colors[5] = vec3(0.5, 0.9, 0.9);

    int idx = int(mod(chamber, 6.0));
    vec3 color = colors[idx];

    // Draw mirror lines
    float lineWidth = 0.02;

    // y-axis mirror
    float mirrorY = abs(p.x);
    color = mix(vec3(0.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, lineWidth, mirrorY));

    // +30 degree mirror: y = x * tan(30) = x / sqrt(3)
    vec2 n1 = vec2(-sin(PI / 6.0), cos(PI / 6.0));
    float mirror1 = abs(dot(p, n1));
    color = mix(vec3(0.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, lineWidth, mirror1));

    // -30 degree mirror: y = -x / sqrt(3)
    vec2 n2 = vec2(sin(PI / 6.0), cos(PI / 6.0));
    float mirror2 = abs(dot(p, n2));
    color = mix(vec3(0.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, lineWidth, mirror2));

    // Draw the triangle outline
    vec2 tp = p;
    tp.x = abs(tp.x);
    tp -= 2.0 * min(dot(tp, vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0) / 2.0)), 0.0)
             * vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0) / 2.0);
    tp.x = abs(tp.x);
    float triDist = -(tp.y + r * 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.025, abs(triDist)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## triangle-2d

```glsl
#define PI 3.14159265

float sdTriangle(vec2 p, float r) {
    // Fold into fundamental domain (3 folds for I_2(3))
    p.x = abs(p.x);
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0) / 2.0)), 0.0)
           * vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0) / 2.0);
    p.x = abs(p.x);

    // Distance to bottom edge
    return -(p.y + r * 0.5);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 2.0;

    float d = sdTriangle(p, 1.2);

    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## octahedron

```glsl
struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

struct Hit {
    float t;
    vec3 point;
    vec3 normal;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Light {
    vec3 dir;
    vec3 color;
};

Ray generateRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitCamera(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

float sdOctahedron(vec3 p, float s) {
    p = abs(p);
    return (p.x + p.y + p.z - s) * 0.57735027;
}

float sceneSDF(vec3 p) {
    return sdOctahedron(p, 1.2);
}

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sceneSDF(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sceneSDF(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sceneSDF(p);
        if (d < 0.001) return t;
        t += d;
        if (t > 100.0) return -1.0;
    }
    return -1.0;
}

vec3 shade(Hit hit, Light light, vec3 viewDir) {
    float diffuse = max(0.0, dot(hit.normal, light.dir));
    vec3 reflected = reflect(-light.dir, hit.normal);
    float specular = pow(max(0.0, dot(reflected, viewDir)), 32.0);

    vec3 diff = hit.color * light.color * diffuse;
    vec3 spec = light.color * specular * 0.5;
    return diff + spec;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = generateRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitCamera(ray, 4.0);

    Light light = Light(normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), vec3(1.0));

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);

        Hit hit;
        hit.t = t;
        hit.point = p;
        hit.normal = normal;
        hit.color = vec3(0.7, 0.3, 0.8);

        vec3 ambient = hit.color * 0.1;
        color = ambient + shade(hit, light, -ray.dir);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```
